activity_summary: You came down after the house was already at work. Joan had nothing to praise you for. Anne had looked at the bench and had not touched the sheet. You said you would look and not sit down to it. The bread waited until you had been out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he would look, and not sit.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Told him the bench was untouched, and held the bread.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted three children and a loaf, and refused a fourth labour.

entities.name: the orchard bench
entities.context: Mentioned in Came down after the house was at work

facets.activity: Came down and went out to the bench

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thou hast come down in time to be praised for nothing.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: The bench is as thou left it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will look. I will not sit down to it.
